Touche le bouton rouge, puis joue : l'ap: Touch the red button, then play: the app writes your notes into the part, and you find them in “Notes”. The figure beside it is the count-in: the bars you hear before playing. “Keep what I just played” takes back what you just played, without playing it again.
Monte le curseur de ce qui doit s'entend: Raise the slider of what must be heard, lower what gets in the way. Under “Output”, a word judges the final volume: “Good” or “Loud and clean” means ready to share; “Clipping” means lower the output. “Reset all” brings back the starting volumes.
La partie en cours tourne en boucle pend: The current part loops while you adjust: you hear what you change right away. “■ Stop” ends the loop.
